page.overview:
Who is Abdar?

Abdar was a legendary spicemonger from Marquet who helped fund the construction of Emon, the capital city of Tal'Dorei — part of Critical Role.

His name is synonymous with generosity and business savvy; Abdar's Promenade, a marketplace district in Emon, was named after him. The street has been mentioned on-stream multiple times, but Abdar himself has neither been mentioned nor appeared on Critical Role.

In Critical Role, Abdar sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
